name: jobclaw
description: 面向中国大陆招聘平台的简历事实约束求职助手

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @jobclaw/core && npm run build --workspace @jobclaw/chrome-extension && npm run build --workspace @jobclaw/desktop-bridge
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @jobclaw/core && npm run typecheck --workspace @jobclaw/chrome-extension && npm run typecheck --workspace @jobclaw/desktop-bridge
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
